# MonitorDaily: Meet the Rising Leaders Shaping the Future of Equipment Finance


*6.3.26*


**


"In our seventh annual NextGen leaders issue, Monitor celebrates emerging leaders of the equipment finance industry. This special section showcases professionals aged 40 and under who are making a real impact. Nominated by our readers and selected by the votes of our editorial board and senior staff, these leaders represent the next wave of innovation, insight and drive in the industry.


...Mike Philbin, chief financial officer of Targeted Lending Co., began his career in equipment finance as an 18-year-old intern. Originally drawn to the diversity of businesses and assets the industry supports, his early curiosity has remained a constant throughout his career."


[Read the full story covered in the MonitorDaily here.](https://www.pioneerny.com/assets/files/vxIOa5OE/Monitor%20May%20June%202026%20Release.pdf#page=62)
